newsitem.title: USA: BANK OF BOSTON Q3 OPER SHR UP, NET DOWN.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF BOSTON Q3 OPER SHR UP, NET DOWN.

text.p: Average number of common shares, in thousands:
Prior period results have been restated to give effect to the Corporation's acquisition of BayBanks, Inc., completed on July 29,1996 and accounted for as a pooling of interests.

NOTE: Operating net income (excluding special items) for the quarter was $197 million, or $1.21 per common share diluted., up 13 percent for net income and 15 percent for EPS from the prior year. This compares with $188 million, or $1.15 per share, in the second quarter of 1996 and $175 million, or $1.05 per share, in the third quarter of 1995. Operating results reflect the acquisition of BayBanks, which was consummated on July 29, 1996. The acquisition has been accounted for using the pooling of interests method.
The third quarter of 1996 included a charge for restructuring and merger-related costs of $180 million ($117 million after-tax) related to the BayBanks acquisition.

Net income for the first nine months of 1996 was $571 million, or $3.48 per share, before special items compared with net income of $498 million, or $3.00 per share, for the first nine months of 1995.
